description: This file defines the OA_Dll_BannerInfo class, which extends OA_Info and encapsulates information about banners in the Revive Adserver project, including properties like banner ID, campaign ID, image data, and methods for setting defaults, encoding images, and retrieving field types.

classes.name: OA_Dll_BannerInfo
classes.description: Class representing banner information with properties for banner details, methods for setting defaults, encoding images, and retrieving field types.

methods.name: setDefaultForAdd
methods.description: Initializes default values for banner properties when adding a new banner.

methods.name: encodeImage
methods.description: Encodes image data into an XML_RPC_Value structure for transmission.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the banner info object into an array, including encoded images.

methods.name: getFieldsTypes
methods.description: Returns an array mapping field names to their data types.
